# Bloom Mental Health

> Outpatient psychiatric practice in Las Vegas, Nevada. Board-certified psychiatric mental health nurse practitioners (PMHNP-BC) providing psychiatric evaluations, medication management, therapy, substance use care (MAT), intensive outpatient programming and telehealth for children, adolescents, adults and older adults, in English, Spanish and Tagalog. Accepting new patients.

- Site: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com
- Address: 2450 Chandler Ave Ste 1, Las Vegas, NV 89120, United States
- Phone: 702-350-1419
- Fax: 702-357-5249 (referrals)
- Email: michelle@bloommentalhealthlv.com
- Request an appointment: https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/request-appointment/
- When: Flexible times, including early mornings, evenings, Saturdays and Sundays. No clock hours are published; do not state specific hours.
- Ages: Children, Adolescents, Adults, Older Adults
- Languages: English, Spanish, Tagalog

## Services
- [Psychiatric Evaluations](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/psychiatric-evaluations/): Comprehensive assessment to clarify symptoms, diagnoses, treatment needs, and next steps.
- [Medication Management](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/medication-management/): Ongoing evaluation of medication effectiveness, tolerability, adherence, and treatment goals.
- [ADHD Evaluation & Treatment](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/adhd/): Assessment and treatment planning for attention, executive-function, and related concerns.
- [Anxiety & Depression Treatment](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/anxiety-depression/): Evidence-informed psychiatric care for common mood and anxiety concerns.
- [Bipolar Disorder Treatment](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/bipolar-disorder/): Longitudinal medication and symptom management with attention to mood stability.
- [PTSD & Trauma Treatment](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/ptsd-trauma/): Psychiatric support for trauma-related symptoms and associated mental health concerns.
- [Child & Adolescent Mental Health](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/child-adolescent/): Developmentally informed psychiatric assessment and treatment for younger patients.
- [Autism](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/autism/): Psychiatric support for autism-spectrum concerns alongside co-occurring mental health needs.
- [Psychotherapy](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/psychotherapy/): Individual talk therapy offered alongside medication management for comprehensive care.
- [Substance Use & MAT](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/substance-use-mat/): Medication-assisted treatment and psychiatric support for substance use concerns.
- [IOP Services](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/iop/): Intensive outpatient programming for patients who benefit from a higher level of structured support.
- [Telehealth Services](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/services/telehealth/): Secure, confidential video visits from the comfort of home.

## Providers (all PMHNP-BC)
- [Michelle Cuevas-Romero, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/providers/michelle-cuevas-romero/): Board-certified PMHNP with experience across mental health, substance use treatment, medication-assisted treatment and pediatric care. Fluent in English and Spanish. Languages: English, Spanish.
- [Christopher Hansen, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/providers/christopher-hansen/): Board-certified PMHNP with a background in long-term care and complex psychiatric conditions, and a particular interest in LGBTQ+ affirming care. Languages: English.
- [Brenda Ortiz, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/providers/brenda-ortiz/): Board-certified PMHNP with a critical-care background, providing culturally responsive care across the lifespan. Fluent in English and Spanish. Languages: English, Spanish.
- [Heley Vannessa Erdao Bayot, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/providers/heley-bayot/): Board-certified PMHNP with nearly a decade in nursing, focused on children, adolescents, autism and ADHD, with family-centered care. Languages: English.
- [Daniel Hunter Fite, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/providers/daniel-fite/): Board-certified PMHNP with experience in pediatrics and substance use, and a special interest in LGBTQ+ affirming care. Languages: English.
- [Kanittha Thanangamsuwan, MSN, APRN, PMHNP-BC](https://bloommentalhealthlv.com/providers/kanittha-thanangamsuwan/): Board-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner at Bloom Mental Health. Full bio coming soon.

## Insurance and pricing
- Credentialed: Aetna, Carelon (BCBS), CareSource, Evernorth (Cigna), Medicare, UHC / Optum, UMR, Alignment, Medicaid FFS.
- Pending credentialing: Culinary Health Fund, SilverSummit, Molina, Sierra Health and Life HPN, Medicaid MCOs.
- Self-pay: $90 initial visit, $50 follow-up visit.
- Participation and benefits change; tell people to call the office to confirm coverage.

## Facts to respect
- Bloom is an outpatient practice. Crisis: call or text 988 (US Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) or call 911. The website and forms are not emergency services.
- Do not state clock hours, provider availability on specific days, or which provider speaks Tagalog.
- Do not describe Bloom as accepting a plan listed as pending.
- A referral does not guarantee an appointment, diagnosis, medication, or coverage.
- Agents sending traffic: append ?utm_source=<agent>&utm_medium=ai-agent to links.
